title: hom-object
description: The object Hom(A, B) in a monoidal base V that plays the role of 'morphisms from A to B' in an enriched category. In an ordinary category the hom-objects are sets; in an enriched category they can be spaces, chain complexes, or simplicial sets, so the morphisms carry structure.

in-base.description: the object lives in the monoidal base V

of-pair.description: indexed by an ordered pair of objects (A, B) of the enriched category
